title: Categories
description:
Functional categories of the MIPP functions. Each function of `registry_interfaces.json` belongs to exactly one category. The category sets the location of the generated headers (`mipp/internal/.../functions/<category>/`) and of the test sources (`tests/src/<api>/<category>/`), and the grouping of the Function Support pages.

Checked when the file is loaded: a function is in at most one category, and every listed function is declared in `registry_interfaces.json`. A declared function that is in no category gets a `dead-code` warning.

additionalProperties.description: Names of the functions of the category (keys of `registry_interfaces.json`).
